heroHeadline: Day 95: CJNG Confirms First East Africa (Kenya) Meth Lab; Plan Kukulkan 14 Days; El Sapo At Large
heroSubtitle: Day 95 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CJNG KENYA METH LAB — EAST AFRICA FIRST (Day 95): U.S. authorities and the Kenyan government confirmed that CJNG operated a clandestine methamphetamine laboratory in Kenya — marking the cartel's first documented East Africa presence. This extends the CJNG transnational manufacturing arc to four continents: West Africa (Nigeria — NDLEA May 21 bust, $362.9M, 2,419 kg meth, 3 Mexican cooks), South Africa (Swartruggens, May 13 — 481 kg, 5 Mexican nationals), Chile (35-year sentences sought), and now Kenya. U.S. AFRICOM's 2026 Posture Statement to Congress confirmed cartel-linked narcotics as a strategic concern in Africa. PLAN KUKULKAN — 14 DAYS: Fourteen days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City vs. South Africa). 111,000+ security personnel deployed; Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 matches) under heightened CJNG-specific protocols; U.S. special forces training Mexican military on stadium attack prevention. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 95: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement target — no capture or elimination reported. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 19: 19 days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9), no confirmed successor plaza boss. TECOMÁN COLIMA AFTERMATH: Official tally (May 27) — 2 CJNG killed, 5 arrested (incl. U.S. citizen from Atlanta transferred via Interpol), 7 IEDs + armored truck seized; narcobloqueos cleared. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 95): Ongoing — Mullin-Sheinbaum 'coordination without subordination' framework active; June bilateral meeting scheduled. DOJ TERRORISM PRECEDENT (May 16): First-ever cartel operative charged under 'material support of terrorism' statutes (María del Rosario Navarro Sánchez). SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested Mar 11), El Jardinero (arrested Apr 27; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested Apr 27), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized.
